observations: LM2 Torah 107 is a two-sentence ethical statement with no bechina constructions anywhere in the text. The Rebbe makes a practical contrast between eating (which strengthens) and taavat niuf / sexual desire (which drains and damages vitality), concluding that this desire is needed only for continuation of the species. For a new package to be warranted, there must be 3 or more concepts connected by explicit bechina language forming an independent domain. This Torah has zero such connections — no 'X הוא בְּחִינַת Y' language appears at all. The teaching is a single causal/contrastive observation, not a conceptual mapping exercise. There is no basis for proposing any new package from this Torah's source text.
